Patient is a 79-year-old female presenting with low back pain. Low back pain began on 07/15/2026. She describes aching pain in the lumbar region without radicular symptoms. NSAIDs were started today, 07/16/2026. She denies trauma, cancer, fever, weight loss, bladder or bowel symptoms, saddle anesthesia, or progressive neurologic deficits. Plan to initiate physical therapy in the coming days and reassess in one week.
